trust.reason: Sources jars are IDE-only navigation aids (requested by Android Studio/IntelliJ sync's download-sources feature); they are never compiled or executed, so trusting them by pattern avoids per-dependency checksum churn while binary jar/aar/pom/module artifacts remain fully verified.

Javadoc jars are IDE-only navigation aids (requested by Android Studio/IntelliJ sync's download-javadoc feature to show library docs/tooltips); they are never compiled or executed, so trusting them by pattern avoids per-dependency checksum churn while binary jar/aar/pom/module artifacts remain fully verified.

Gradle distribution source archives are IDE-only navigation aids (requested by Android Studio/IntelliJ Gradle sync to resolve the Gradle API/wrapper sources); they are never compiled or executed, so trusting them by pattern avoids per-Gradle-version checksum churn while binary jar/aar/pom/module artifacts remain fully verified.
